description: Valid AdCP task types across all domains. These represent the complete set of operations that can be tracked via the task management system.

enumDescriptions.accept_proposal: Media-buy domain: Accept a committed proposal to create, amend, or cancel a MediaBuy
enumDescriptions.acquire_rights: Brand domain: Acquire rights from a brand agent with contractual clearance and generation credentials
enumDescriptions.activate_signal: Signals domain: Activate an audience signal on a specific platform or account
enumDescriptions.build_creative: Creative domain: Generate, transform, refine, or retrieve a creative manifest
enumDescriptions.buy_products: Media-buy domain: Create a MediaBuy directly from published product offers without inline creatives
enumDescriptions.control_media_buy: Media-buy domain: Apply operational delivery controls inside accepted commercial terms
enumDescriptions.create_media_buy: Media-buy domain: Create a new advertising campaign with one or more packages
enumDescriptions.create_property_list: Property domain: Create a new property list with filters and brand reference
enumDescriptions.decline_proposals: Media-buy domain: Terminally decline immutable proposals and prevent later execution
enumDescriptions.delete_property_list: Property domain: Delete a property list
enumDescriptions.get_account_financials: Account domain: Query financial status of an operator-billed account (spend, credit, invoices)
enumDescriptions.get_brand_identity: Brand domain: Retrieve brand identity data (logos, colors, tone, assets, voice config) from a brand agent
enumDescriptions.get_creative_delivery: Creative domain: Retrieve variant-level creative delivery data
enumDescriptions.get_creative_features: Creative domain: Evaluate a creative manifest through a replay-protected provider evaluation
enumDescriptions.get_principal: Protocol domain: Read caller-scoped agent connection configuration, its version, and destination setup states without mutation
enumDescriptions.get_products: Media-buy domain: Discover or refine advertising products and proposals
enumDescriptions.get_property_list: Property domain: Retrieve a property list with resolved properties
enumDescriptions.get_rights: Brand domain: Search for licensable rights across a brand agent's roster with pricing
enumDescriptions.get_signals: Signals domain: Discover available audience signals based on natural language description
enumDescriptions.list_property_lists: Property domain: List all accessible property lists
enumDescriptions.log_event: Media-buy domain: Send conversion or marketing events for attribution
enumDescriptions.media_buy_delivery: Media-buy domain: Persistent delivery-report webhook event emitted for a configured reporting_webhook. The inner result uses media-buy-delivery-webhook-result.json.
enumDescriptions.preview_creative: Creative domain: Render a read-only preview of an existing creative manifest or library creative
enumDescriptions.refine_proposals: Media-buy domain: Create draft revisions or finalize drafts into held committed proposals
enumDescriptions.request_proposals: Media-buy domain: Request seller-authored proposals from a campaign brief
enumDescriptions.search_brands: Brand domain: Discover brands on a brand agent's roster via natural language query; returns lightweight identity stubs
enumDescriptions.sync_accounts: Account domain: Sync advertiser accounts with a seller using upsert semantics
enumDescriptions.sync_agent_notification_configs: Protocol domain: Register agent-level webhook subscribers such as capabilities.changed cache-invalidation notifications
enumDescriptions.sync_audiences: Media-buy domain: Manage first-party CRM audiences on an account with delta upsert semantics
enumDescriptions.sync_catalogs: Media-buy domain: Sync catalog feeds (products, inventory, stores, promotions, offerings) to a platform with approval workflow
enumDescriptions.sync_creatives: Media-buy domain: Sync creative assets to publisher's library with upsert semantics
enumDescriptions.sync_event_sources: Media-buy domain: Configure event sources on an account with upsert semantics
enumDescriptions.sync_principal: Protocol domain: Synchronize caller-scoped agent connection configuration, including webhooks and reusable reporting destinations
enumDescriptions.sync_reporting_receipts: Media-buy domain: Submit authenticated consumer reconciliation outcomes for reporting materializations
enumDescriptions.sync_reporting_status: Media-buy domain: Submit authenticated consumer status for expected reporting periods
enumDescriptions.update_media_buy: Media-buy domain: Update campaign settings, package configuration, or delivery parameters
enumDescriptions.update_property_list: Property domain: Update an existing property list
enumDescriptions.update_rights: Brand domain: Update an existing rights grant, including its term, impression cap, pricing option, or pause state

notes: Task types map to specific AdCP task operations
Each task type belongs to the 'media-buy', 'signals', 'property', 'account', 'creative', or 'brand' domain
This enum is used in task management APIs (tasks/list, tasks/get) and webhook payloads
New task types require a minor version bump per semantic versioning
title: Task Type
